summary: Iteration-11 BACKEND 5/5 + FRONTEND 11/11 features verified end-to-end. Backend: polis_enabled/asuransi_enabled flags on receive (False default, missing key=False backward-compat, true preserves amount, mixed on/off) all pass. /api/invoices/{iid}/full now returns company.signer/bank_name/bank_holder/bank_account/logo_b64 in addition to name/npwp/address. Frontend: OrderInput city datalist new 'NAMA - SINGKATAN' format (JAKARTA - JKT), origin field preserves casing 'Jakarta - JKT', Qty label single 'QTY' (no more 'Qty Isi per Koli'), Grand Total excludes Polis/Asuransi (Rp 111.000 with tariff 10k*10+11% PPN). Recap page has search-nocost/ready/reconciled data-testids; selection preserved across filter (1 before, 1 after). Receive modal has receive-polis-check/receive-asuransi-check/receive-spsi-check/receive-forklift-check + receive-total-preview that updates real-time (Rp 11.100 -> Rp 61.100 when polis=50k toggled on). InvoicesCreated has invoice-search + invoice-customer-filter labeled 'CARI (OR)' and 'FILTER CUSTOMER (OR)' working as union. PanjarKerja breakdown-awb-0 dropdown lists 20 AWBs including Open + Invoiced + Paid statuses (verified: 'AWB-202606-0113 · Invoiced · ...', '...· Open · ...'). InvoicePrint /arc/invoices/{id}/print rendered new AR Cargo template: grey INVOICE banner, No/DESCRIPTION/AMOUNT table headers, Indonesian date '16 Juni 2026', Terbilang in Bahasa ('Seratus Delapan Puluh Satu Ribu Seratus Rupiah'), BANK ADDRESS Mandiri box on left, signer block on right, Lampiran section present, Faktur Pajak section REMOVED.
verified_features: Backend: POST /api/orders/{id}/receive with polis_enabled=false + polis_amount=20000 => received_polis_amount=0
Backend: missing polis_enabled/asuransi_enabled keys defaults to False (backward compat) — amounts ignored
Backend: mixed (polis_enabled=true + asuransi_enabled=false) keeps polis amt, zeros asuransi
Backend: GET /api/invoices/{iid}/full returns company.{name,npwp,address,signer,bank_name,bank_holder,bank_account,logo_b64} all present; bank_name defaults to 'Mandiri'

Frontend OrderInput: datalist contains 'JAKARTA - JKT', 'SURABAYA - SBY', 'SEMARANG - SMG', ..., 'BALIKPAPAN - BPN' etc. Origin input preserves 'Jakarta - JKT' (no toUpperCase). Qty label is 'QTY' only ('Qty Isi per Koli' removed). Grand Total=Rp 111.000 (=100k+11%PPN, excludes polis 20k & asuransi 100k).
Frontend Recap: search-nocost/search-ready/search-reconciled testids all present. Selection preserved when filter cleared (1 before, 1 after).

Frontend Receive modal: receive-polis-check/receive-asuransi-check/receive-spsi-check/receive-forklift-check + receive-total-preview present. polis-check default OFF for order with no polis. Preview real-time: Rp 11.100 -> Rp 61.100 after toggling polis ON with 50k amount.
Frontend InvoicesCreated: invoice-search + invoice-customer-filter present with 'OR' label. Both fields apply union logic.
Frontend PanjarKerja: breakdown-awb-0 dropdown contains 20 AWBs with statuses Open + Invoiced + Paid all visible.

Frontend InvoicePrint AR Cargo template: grey INVOICE banner ✓, No/DESCRIPTION/AMOUNT header ✓, '16 Juni 2026' Indonesian date ✓, 'Terbilang: Seratus Delapan Puluh Satu Ribu Seratus Rupiah' ✓, BANK ADDRESS box with Mandiri ✓, signer block on right ✓, Lampiran table ✓, Faktur Pajak REMOVED ✓.
critical_code_review_comments: Receive endpoint correctly multiplies amount by enabled flag (server.py L1357-1358): polis_eff=float(data.polis_amount or 0) if data.polis_enabled else 0 — guarantees backward-compat with old clients that send polis_amount without the enable flag.
InvoicePrint amber box logic '(polisAmt > 0 || insAmt > 0)' correctly conditional in OrderInput.js L399.
Per-issuer bank settings fall back to 'Mandiri' default in /api/invoices/{id}/full — clean.
seed_data_creation: Created ~6 new TEST_IT11 orders for receive flag tests + invoice for /full endpoint test. Customer TEST_IT11_CUST_1781570592 reused.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-11 is fully green on both backend and frontend. Receive flag semantics now strictly: amount saved only if corresponding enable flag is True; absent enable flag defaults to False (so any pre-existing client that sends polis_amount without polis_enabled will now save 0 — INTENTIONAL per new contract). InvoicePrint /arc/invoices/{id}/print renders the new AR Cargo template with all required sections.
